title: fagara mantchurica var. subinermis
intro: Fagara mantchurica var. subinermis, commonly known as Korean Zanthoxylum, is a type of plant in the Rutaceae family, known for its unique properties and uses. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Fagara mantchurica var. subinermis include its potential to relieve pain, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
